main_text.p: Vt 3/8 à 7/8 subducantur, reliquuntur 4/8 seu 1/2. Item subduc 1/3 à 1/1 3. Hic partes diuersi nominis primùm reducere oportet, in 1/3 3/9 & 3/3 0/9, facta dein subtractione numerorum inter se, scilicet 13 à 30, relinquuntur 17, denominanda à communi nomine, unde inuentæ partes erunt 1/3 7/9. Exemplum sic est:
Prima species essentialis partium numerationis sic est: secunda inuento diuersum à datis partibus nomen tribuit, estq; uel Multiplicatio, uel Diuisio.
Multiplicatio est, quæ homogeneos partium terminos inter se multiplicas, factos ex ijs, pro quæsitarū partium terminis usurpat.

p.i: Multiplicatio hæc propriè inuentio est partium aliarum, ita se ad datarum alteras habentium, sicut reliquæ ad unitatem: quæ quidem fit, datarum partium tum numeris, tum nominibus inter se multiplicatis. Unde necessariò concluditur, inuentas partes multiplicatis semper minores esse.
Vt si 1/2 sit per 1/3 multiplicanda, numeratoribus atque

page.notes: The fraction table is partly garbled in the scan; the numerators and denominators of the subtraction columns are given as best read. The table lines are reconstructed from the layout. The catchword "quæ" at the foot is written as "atque" continuation; the last word is read as "que" with a small superscript c.
